record.question: To rise like a phoenix
options: to rise with a new life
to get up with a start
record.explanation: Answer A: to rise with a new life. Rise like a phoenix means recover/re-emerge with renewed life (A). Independent check: “Rise like a phoenix” means recover or emerge renewed after destruction or defeat. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/phoenix; https://www.britannica.com/topic/phoenix-mythological-bird. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
